core.jd_text: The Staff Product Engineer at Blacksmith operates at the organization level, owning architecture, solving complex product problems, and driving 0-1 product initiatives that shape how Blacksmith grows. Responsibilities: own and drive architectural direction for new products (designing next-gen AI-native developer tooling that doesn't exist in the industry today); translate business/product strategy into long-term technical roadmaps; drive 0-1 product development; own production outcomes (reliability, performance, operational excellence); mentor senior engineers; operate in ambiguous problem spaces. Requirements: track record setting technical direction of a product from early stage to industry-recognized scale; power user of coding agents (team builds background agents and operates at the forefront of agentic development); strong communication across technical/non-technical stakeholders; 8+ years experience. Compensation: $280K-$380K base + equity, early-exercise stock options, unlimited PTO, unlimited agent tokens, 12 weeks paid parental leave.

extension.funding_or_layoff_signal: Well-capitalized and actively scaling: $3.5M seed (May 2025) -> $10M Series A (Sep 2025, Google Ventures) -> $45M Series B (Aug 12, 2026, led by Peak XV Partners, existing investors YC and GV participating), valuing the company at $550M. Total funding $58.5M. New capital explicitly earmarked for compute infrastructure, tying growth to real product demand rather than pure headcount vanity metrics.
unlisted_tech_stack: coding agents / agentic dev tooling (internal 'codesmith' product)
extension.repost_pattern: Not a recycled single req: Blacksmith's own careers page lists 14 distinct concurrent open roles (Staff Product Engineer, Senior Product Engineer, Staff/Senior Systems Engineer, Enterprise PM, GM Sandboxes, etc.), consistent with genuine broad-based post-Series-B scaling rather than an evergreen or recycled single posting.

verdict.label: ATTAINABLE
verdict.rationale: This clears the winnability gate cleanly: cross-listed directly on Blacksmith's own careers page (confirmed live, not aggregator-only), salary band is transparent and matches seniority/market rate for a Staff-level 0-1 architecture role, and the company just closed a $45M Series B at a $550M valuation with new capital explicitly directed at infrastructure scaling (evidence e1-e3). The absence of a single recycled req - instead 14 concurrent distinct open roles - rules out the evergreen/recycled-posting pattern that made the Parloa dossier UNDECIDABLE (evidence e4). No extraction-risk or data-privacy flags surfaced. No countervailing evidence found to route this to human premortem.
